Class SynchronizedWaveSource<TBaseSource, T>

Namespace
SilverCraft.CSCore.Streams
Assembly
SilverCraft.CSCore.dll

A thread-safe (synchronized) wrapper around the specified a IReadableAudioSource<T>.

public class SynchronizedWaveSource<TBaseSource, T> : IAggregator<T, TBaseSource>, IReadableAudioSource<T>, IAudioSource, IDisposable where TBaseSource : class, IReadableAudioSource<T>

The type of the underlying IReadableAudioSource<T>.

T

Read(T[], int, int)

Reads a sequence of elements from the BaseSource and advances its position by the number of elements read.

public int Read(T[] buffer, int offset, int count)

Parameters

buffer T[]

An array of elements. When this method returns, the buffer contains the specified array of elements with the values between offset and (offset + count - 1) replaced by the elements read from the current source.

offset int

The zero-based offset in the buffer at which to begin storing the data read from the current stream.

count int

The maximum number of elements to read from the current source.

Returns

int

The total number of elements read into the buffer.
